children: Central banks around the world are scrambling to meet inflation pressures head on and the Reserve Bank of New Zealand will be no different, says Sharon Zollner, chief economist at ANZ. It now forecasts interest rate hikes by the RBNZ in October, February and March, which would take the official cash rate to a peak of 3.50%. The view adds two hikes to the forecast profile. Higher oil prices, a lower exchange rate, and a better starting point for the economy are driving the forecast, she says. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
